wrong_claims: Gap G1, 'Why I cannot prove it': 'When T(Z)!=0 it is not in the span of products of divisor classes, because it is non-zero on T(S)' is an invalid inference. For an abelian threefold Z and a smooth ample surface S in Z, the divisor class D in H^1(S)xH^1(Z) induced by the polarization gives D.D in H^2(S)xH^2(Z), which acts injectively on iota^*H^2(Z), so it is non-zero on iota^*T(Z) inside T(S).
